title: TiltFilter - first-order tilt shelf, per-voice distinct magnitudes, pivot ~700 Hz
description:
Implement Source/DSP/TiltFilter.h and Source/DSP/TiltFilter.cpp — per-voice first-order spectral tilt per ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.5B.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §4.5B (pivot ~700 Hz, per-voice dB magnitudes)
- Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.h or MonoSafetyCrossover.h for small filter prepare/process style if present

Implement class TiltFilter:
1. First-order tilt shelf: low-shelf boost / high-shelf cut of equal small magnitude (or equivalent first-order tilt transfer) pivoting near 700 Hz so DC and Nyquist move oppositely by ~±tiltDb/2 with flat-ish overall loudness.
2. Per-voice default magnitudes (setVoiceIndex 0..3):
   - V1 +1.5 dB bright
   - V2 -1.5 dB dark
   - V3 +0.8 dB
   - V4 -0.8 dB
3. prepare(sampleRate) recomputes coefficients from pivotHz (default 700) and tiltDb; setTiltDb / setPivotHz allowed; coefficient update only in prepare or explicit setter (not per-sample alloc).
4. processSample(float) noexcept; reset() clears filter state. No heap in process. Subtle by design — default magnitudes stay small.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: TiltFilter is a first-order tilt shelf with default pivot approximately 700 Hz
setVoiceIndex or defaults provide V1=+1.5 V2=-1.5 V3=+0.8 V4=-0.8 dB tilt magnitudes
prepare/reset/processSample exist; no allocation outside prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement multi-band graphic EQ or FFT processing

allowed: biquad or one-pole/one-zero first-order tilt topology
coefficient recompute on prepare and tilt/pivot setters
